measures.questionText: Should two additional supervisors be elected to serve in this township?
measures.officialStatement:
The purpose of the ballot question is to determine whether the electors of Wolf
Township favor increasing the size of the township’s Board of Supervisors to five
members from the current number of three members. Wolf Township would then
have five elected Supervisors instead of three elected Supervisors.

If the question is approved as a result of the number of “Yes” votes being greater
than the number of “No” votes, then one additional Supervisor would be elected
to a six-year term and one additional Supervisor would be elected to a four-year
term on the 2027 municipal ballot in order to effect the increase, in addition to the
normal number of Supervisors to be elected. Thereafter, Supervisors would be
elected corresponding to the number of Supervisors whose terms are scheduled to
expire on the first Monday of the following January.

If the question is not approved as a result of the number of “No” votes being
greater than or equal to the number of “Yes” votes, then the number of elected
Supervisors for Wolf Township would remain at three.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Merges Cassandra Borough in Cambria County into Portage Township in Cambria County, effective January 1, 2027.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve merging Cassandra Borough into Portage Township on January 1, 2027.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Reduces Dudley Borough Council from 7 members to 3 members.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve reducing the council to 3 members.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject reducing the council from 7 members to 3.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Establishes a dedicated Lancaster County tax on all taxable real estate to maintain and support public libraries. The rate would be 0.55 mills, equal to $0.55 for each $1,000 of taxable real estate value.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the dedicated library tax at 0.55 mills on all taxable real estate in the county.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed county library tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Increases Wolf Township’s elected Board of Supervisors from 3 members to 5. It passes only if Yes votes outnumber No votes. At the 2027 municipal election, voters would elect one additional supervisor for 6 years and one for 4 years, in addition to the supervisors normally elected. Later elections would fill the number of seats whose terms expire on the first Monday of the following January.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve expanding the board to 5 members using the described 2027 and later election schedule.
measureRecords.noMeans: Keep 3 elected supervisors. A tie also rejects the proposed expansion.
